questions.question_text: Who among the following was the founder of the Indian National Congress?
questions.explanation: Allan Octavian Hume (A.O. Hume), a retired British civil servant, was the primary founder of the Indian National Congress in 1885.

questions.question_text: Which Article of the Indian Constitution is related to the Right to Equality?
questions.explanation: Articles 14 to 18 of the Indian Constitution guarantee the Right to Equality to all citizens.

questions.question_text: Which of the following ocean currents is a cold current?
questions.explanation: The Canary Current is a wind-driven surface current that is part of the North Atlantic Gyre. It is a cold, wide, and slow-moving current.

questions.question_text: Exercise 'Surya Kiran' is a joint military exercise between India and which country?
questions.explanation: Surya Kiran is an annual joint military exercise conducted between the Indian Army and the Nepali Army.

questions.question_text: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
questions.explanation: The SI unit of electrical resistance is the ohm (Ω).

questions.question_text: Which country recently hosted the G20 Summit in 2023?
questions.explanation: India held the Presidency of the G20 from 1 December 2022 to 30 November 2023 and hosted the summit in New Delhi.

questions.question_text: What does the term 'Stagflation' refer to?

options.A: High inflation and high economic growth
options.B: Low inflation and low economic growth
options.C: High inflation and stagnant economic growth

questions.explanation: Stagflation is an economic condition characterized by slow economic growth and relatively high unemployment—economic stagnation—which is at the same time accompanied by rising prices (i.e., inflation).

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a stealth guided-missile destroyer built under Project 15B?
questions.explanation: INS Visakhapatnam (D66) is the lead ship of the Visakhapatnam-class stealth guided-missile destroyers of the Indian Navy, built under Project 15B.

questions.question_text: Which Maurya ruler was known by the title 'Devanampiya Piyadasi'?
questions.explanation: Ashoka used the titles 'Devanampiya' (Beloved of the Gods) and 'Piyadasi' (He who regards everyone with affection) in his edicts.

questions.question_text: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.explanation: Gujarat has the longest mainland coastline in India.
